method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Cat Act 2011 (WA) compilation 00-l0-01 (amendments to No. 29 of 2021 in force; Stop Puppy Farming ss 50-61 and Evidence Act 2025 s 492(1) uncommenced), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/cat-act-2011-00-l0-01.txt (retrieved 2026-09-07); Cat Regulations 2012 compilation 02-b0-00 (to SL 2025/138, in force 24 July 2025), ../../registers/source-bundle/cat-regulations-2012.txt; Cat (Uniform Local Provisions) Regulations 2013 compilation 00-a0-05, ../../registers/source-bundle/cat-uniform-local-provisions-regulations-2013.txt

checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: From the seat of the cat owner: who is the owner (s 4); the 6-month day; the duties to register (s 5, reg 9), tag (s 6, reg 10), microchip (s 14) and sterilise (s 18) with their exemptions; when an application must be refused (s 9(2)-(4)); the registration fee (Sch 3: $10/$20 one year, $42.50 three years, $100 life, 50% for pensioners) and period (reg 12); giving a cat away or selling it (s 23, reg 19); notice of a change (s 25); the number of cats (s 79(3)(h), ULP regs 4-7); the $5,000 maximum fines and $200 modified penalties. Out: implanters', vets' and database companies' duties, Part 3 (control notices, seizure, facilities, breeding approvals), Part 4 enforcement and review, machinery.
lives: chloe c076 (2036-02-14): A cat, Biscuit: sterilised, microchipped, registered
